IO3_transformations.algorithm: Match make/model/year in NHTSA or static database. Return dimensions, capacity.

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Vehicles used for evacuation capacity calculation

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Vehicle spec database lookup (should be <500ms). Manual spec override (user may know better).
P.P2_defensibility: NHTSA database is authoritative. User can override if spec wrong. Multi-vehicle support for large households.
P.P3_confidence_level: High confidence. NHTSA API is reliable source.
P4_failure_modes: Database lookup fails → user enters specs manually (acceptable fallback)
Wrong vehicle matched (make/model ambiguity) → wrong specs used (mitigate: show matched vehicle, let user correct)
P.P5_backup_plan: If database unavailable: show manual entry form. Allow user override always.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Test with vehicles not in database (manual entry). Test user override. Test multi-vehicle.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for spec lookup. Integration tests with NHTSA API. Manual entry tests. Multi-vehicle tests.
P.P8_benchmarks: Vehicle entry: <500ms (with database lookup). Auto-fill accuracy: 95%.

L.L4_liability_notes: Vehicle specs used for evacuation planning (inaccuracy could affect routing). Mitigation: user can override.

F.F1_cost_considerations: NHTSA API: free or low-cost. Vehicle storage: negligible.
F.F3_revenue_impact: Vehicle tracking enables evacuation planning (value driver).

S.S2_data_privacy: Vehicle info visible to matched users (during evacuation).
S.S4_access_control: User controls own vehicles. Admin can see vehicles for support.

X.X1_notes: Vehicle specs critical for evacuation planning (capacity, clearance, 4WD). NHTSA database provides authoritative data. User override important (user knows their vehicle better). Multi-vehicle households supported.
X2_open_questions: Vehicle spec database: NHTSA API, static dataset, user input only? (API is best, has cost)
Vehicle maintenance: track fuel, tires, readiness? (future, not MVP)
X.X3_related_research: NHTSA API. Vehicle dimension standards. Evacuation vehicle capacity estimation.
